newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dollar edges up vs yen in late Tokyo trade.
newsitem.headline: Dollar edges up vs yen in late Tokyo trade.

text.p: 0540 GMT --*Dollar edged up against yen in late Tokyo due to short-covering and partly to weak Tokyo stocks. *Short-covering took place after downside found firm at around 112.50 yen due to bids from Japanese investors, including trust banks, public funds.*Dollar steady just above 1.76 marks, as offers from European operators capped advance.
